paper_title: VOYAGER: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
core_problem: Developing lifelong learning embodied agents capable of open-ended exploration and continuous skill acquisition without human intervention in complex environments like Minecraft.
methodology_summary: VOYAGER uses GPT-4 via an iterative prompting framework for novelty search, combining an automatic curriculum, an executable skill library, and environment execution feedback for code generation and self-correction.
empirical_results: VOYAGER outperforms prior SOTA by obtaining 3.3x more unique items, unlocking advanced tech tree levels (Wooden to Diamond tools), and showing efficient zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks.
explicit_limitations: LLMs can get stuck and fail to generate correct code skills; text-only modal inputs lack direct visual observation handling; reliance on GPT-4 since smaller open-source models struggle with task execution.
